# Confirm the home quick action stays applied after refresh

## What & Why
The dashboard can mark an application as applied without opening the application editor. A browser regression test should ensure that user-visible shortcut remains persisted after a reload.

## Done looks like
- A browser test creates an application, uses the home page's Mark applied action, and verifies the Applied status after reload.
- The test covers the application count/status shown on the dashboard and the application queue.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
